name: M8-6A-12, 1PS
headline: Modern & Mellow 1 BDR @ Mangroovy | Free Beach & Pool Access
summary: This modern 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays.

description.Space:
This warm and welcoming 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The apartment is on the first floor and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 1 bathroom and a living room. There is a bright and cozy outdoor furnished terrace, perfect for your morning coffee or late night relaxation. 

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests a relaxing vibe.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Marina El Gouna. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Positive:
The apartments are in a perfect location, with the beach very close by. There are free sunbeds, and next to the apartments there is a so-called beach club. There are three beach clubs you can use, but those are paid. The area is very nice, the marina is very close, you can walk there, and you can also take a tuk-tuk to downtown — it takes about 10 minutes, even less. It’s a very nice little town, a very peaceful place.

As for the cleanliness of the apartments, I do have a few comments. The apartment itself is very nice, but unfortunately some things are a bit worn out, and in terms of cleanliness, the apartment wasn’t cleaned properly. We pointed this out to the staff responsible, so they came and did a light cleaning, and they fixed the issues that were overlooked, although they didn’t fix them completely well.
